LEAD | program: keeper | function: load_with_positions | bug_class: hardening-version-unchecked | group_key: keeper | load_with_positions | hardening-version-unchecked
location: services/keeper/src/view.rs:263; services/keeper/src/view.rs:284; keeper::load_with_positions
title: The keeper loads account layouts without their version checks.
code_smells: decode_zc checks the owner, discriminator, and minimum byte length; load_with_positions accepts GlobalConfig and Market without a version check.
description: The keeper interprets a future account layout with its old types if an upgrade preserves the discriminator and minimum size.
proof: view.rs:48-55 uses pod_read_unaligned after the owner/discriminator/size checks. load_with_positions:263-267 accepts GlobalConfig, and its market loop accepts decoded Market data before venue_kind; neither compares CONFIG_VERSION or MARKET_VERSION. The on-chain open_short Accounts constraints require both versions. A stored version byte different from the expected version therefore reaches keeper projection while the on-chain instruction refuses it. No currently reachable unauthorized state write or direct fund loss was proved.
fix: Check each decoded config and market version before the keeper uses its fields.

FINDING | program: keeper | function: resolve_entry | bug_class: unsupported-coin-creator-placeholder | group_key: keeper | resolve_entry | unsupported-coin-creator-placeholder
file: services/keeper/src/venue.rs:675
location: keeper::resolve_entry
title: The keeper drops valid coin creator extras.
root_cause: resolve_entry omits PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR even though the on-chain validator and parser support it from the PumpSwap cache.
assumption: The coin creator cannot be resolved from the market cache.
violation: A valid PumpSwap market already contains CACHED_COIN_CREATOR, and the on-chain parser uses that exact cached value.
path: Emergency or Governance publishes a valid template with coin_creator -> keeper decodes VenueExtras -> resolve_entry returns None -> choice_of returns None -> extras_candidates omits the set -> keeper cannot build the supported configured exit variant.
proof: Construct one ExtraEntry with kind=ENTRY_TEMPLATE, n_seeds=1, seeds[0].kind=SEED_PLACEHOLDER, seeds[0].len=PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR (4), zero seed bytes, a nonzero external program key, and a derived account outside the denylists. programs/shortwin/src/venues/mod.rs::check_entry accepts placeholder IDs through PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR. set_venue_extras validates and writes that entry. The program's Placeholders::key resolves ID 4, and venues/mod.rs:1264-1268 supplies pump_amm::cached(market, CACHED_COIN_CREATOR) on PumpSwap. The keeper's venue.rs:670-677 handles IDs for mint, pool, trader and bonding_curve only; ID 4 reaches `_ => None`, despite the next comment claiming that the cache cannot supply it. At lines 703-704 choice_of propagates None; extras_candidates lines 738-746 drops current, previous and stable independently if they contain this template. With otherwise empty sets, its result is only ExtrasChoice::none(), even though the configured set is valid on chain.
impact: This proves unsupported configured functionality for every coin_creator template. A venue interface that requires that account defeats the intended extras-only recovery of keeper exits. The current deployed venue was not proved to require such an extra; no present liquidation loss is claimed.
description: The keeper omits every extras set with the supported coin creator placeholder, so it cannot build those configured exits.
fix: Resolve PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR from the same PumpSwap cache as the program.
minimal_unified_diff:
```diff
--- a/services/keeper/src/venue.rs
+++ b/services/keeper/src/venue.rs
@@ -58,8 +58,8 @@
 use shortwin::state::pump_swap_cache;
 use shortwin::state::{
     ENTRY_FIXED, ENTRY_TEMPLATE, EXTRAS_MAX_SEEDS, ExtraEntry, ExtrasSet, Market,
-    PLACEHOLDER_BONDING_CURVE, PLACEHOLDER_MINT, PLACEHOLDER_POOL, PLACEHOLDER_TRADER, SEED_CONST,
-    SEED_PLACEHOLDER, VenueExtras, VenueKind,
+    PLACEHOLDER_BONDING_CURVE, PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR, PLACEHOLDER_MINT, PLACEHOLDER_POOL,
+    PLACEHOLDER_TRADER, SEED_CONST, SEED_PLACEHOLDER, VenueExtras, VenueKind,
 };
 use shortwin::venues::{
     EXTRAS_SET_CURRENT, EXTRAS_SET_PREVIOUS, EXTRAS_SET_STABLE, ExtrasSel, pump_amm, pump_curve,
@@ -672,7 +672,9 @@
                             PLACEHOLDER_POOL => pool_placeholder(kind, market),
                             PLACEHOLDER_TRADER => Some(market.trader),
                             PLACEHOLDER_BONDING_CURVE => Some(market.bonding_curve),
-                            // The coin creator is not resolvable from the market cache.
+                            PLACEHOLDER_COIN_CREATOR if kind == VenueKind::PumpSwap => {
+                                Some(pump_amm::cached(market, pump_swap_cache::CACHED_COIN_CREATOR))
+                            }
                             _ => None,
                         }?;
                         owned.push(key.to_bytes().to_vec());
```
validation: Static cross-file trace only. The patch mirrors the program's cached value, including its venue guard; it does not substitute the live creator. No tests or builds ran.

LEAD | program: keeper | function: check_foreign | bug_class: held-liquidity-freeze-residual | group_key: keeper | check_foreign | held-liquidity-freeze-residual
file: services/keeper/src/coverage.rs:47
location: keeper::check_foreign
title: Coverage preserves a previously observed liquidity low.
code_smells: The keeper detects foreign bucket extremes but cannot restore a liquidity low that earlier genuine observations established.
assumption: Honest per-second observations are enough to remove the effects of an LP's temporary withdrawal.
violation: An LP first holds a withdrawal through genuine observations, then wraps later cranks with withdrawals and redeposits.
proof: coverage.rs:36-50 documents that the keeper's liquidity window holds the EMA but cannot lift a low reached during a genuine withdrawal; the low stays frozen at one attacker transaction per keeper observation (FITX-1, O18). check_foreign compares the bucket against that second's depth view and starts per-second coverage, without a separate recovery rule for a genuinely established low. The source calls this an accepted residual; acceptance is not a code guard.
description: An LP can preserve a previously observed liquidity low; this pass did not independently prove the resulting settlement or profit.
unverified: The full observation, liquidation and settlement sequence and its current bounds were not independently reproduced in this pass. Retained because the assigned source expressly reaches the known residual.

FINDING | program: shortwin-keeper | function: evaluate | bug_class: wrong-window-floor-reference | group_key: shortwin-keeper | evaluate | wrong-window-floor-reference
file: services/keeper/src/pool_monitor.rs:376
title: The keeper accepts a pool that the proposal floor rejects
seam: economics×asymmetry
actor: A permissionless pool creator or trader who supplies a deep pool with a lower spot price.
root_cause: The keeper evaluates the proposal floor at P_ema, but propose_pool evaluates it at min(P_ema, P_cand).
path: A valid low-spot candidate enters discovery → evaluate records window_floor=true at P_ema → plan selects its greater D → propose_pool rejects PoolTooThin → the keeper backs off and selects it again.
proof: All amounts below are base units; 1 SOL = 1e9 lamports. Use pool_min_real_sol=25e9, lambda_min=5000, P_ema=1e18, an armed failed incumbent, and two executable 25-bps pools with fully burned LP. A has X=500e9, Y=5e9, D=50e9 and P_cand=1e16. B has X=Y=D=30e9 and P_cand=1e18. Both satisfy verify_candidate's P_ema eligibility floor. evaluate calls window_floor_ok(&a, params, p_ref), so it records locked SOL of 50e9 for A and 30e9 for B. plan ranks by D and selects A. propose_pool.rs:315-318 instead passes window_price(p_ref,&adoption); A has 50e9*isqrt(1e16)/1e9=5e9, below 25e9, while B has 30e9 and passes. Take one carried position q=150000000, L_slow=30e9, min_open_fee_ppm=2500, the default caps (fee_size_cap_x100=300, fee_oi_cap_x100=750), and an empty oracle cache (Tier C). Both candidates have X0>=30e9 at both checked prices, so the fee-size cap is at least 225000000 and the OI cap is at least 562500000; Tier C impact caps are looser. The position fits both; the false floor alone rejects A. keeper.rs:3532-3587 only records backoff and alerts after a refusal; it does not exclude A. This is a static correctness trace, not a claim that arbitrage leaves differing pool prices unchanged indefinitely.
guards: Candidate accounts remain real, owned by the pinned Raydium program, and reverified on chain; those checks reject the keeper's selected action but do not choose B.
economic_delta: The keeper fails to start a feasible collection window, so existing positions remain on the failed incumbent and their rent and settlement clocks continue.
description: The keeper selects a pool that the on-chain floor rejects, so borrowers miss a viable pool switch.
fix: Use the proposal's minimum price when the keeper computes a candidate's window floor.
minimal_diff:
```diff
--- a/services/keeper/src/pool_monitor.rs
+++ b/services/keeper/src/pool_monitor.rs
@@ -373,7 +373,11 @@
             d: a.state.locked_depth,
             real_sol: a.state.r,
             fee_ppm: a.state.fee_ppm,
-            window_floor: pool_select::window_floor_ok(&a, params, p_ref),
+            window_floor: pool_select::window_floor_ok(
+                &a,
+                params,
+                pool_select::window_price(p_ref, &a),
+            ),
             fits: pool_select::carried_fit(market, &a, fit, p_ref, FitAt::Proposal)
                 .is_ok_and(|f| f.fits()),
         },
```

LEAD | program: shortwin-keeper | function: decode_zc | bug_class: hardening-version-unchecked | group_key: shortwin-keeper | decode_zc | hardening-version-unchecked
file: services/keeper/src/view.rs:48
title: The keeper reads account layouts without checking their versions
seam: access×economics
actor: An honest protocol upgrade that retains an account discriminator and size but changes its layout version.
code_smells: decode_zc checks the owner and discriminator, but load_with_positions accepts GlobalConfig, Market, and VenueExtras without their version guards.
trace: view.rs:48-56 copies sizeof(T) bytes through pod_read_unaligned; load_with_positions uses the copies to choose venues and evaluate economic rules. On-chain accounts enforce CONFIG_VERSION or MARKET_VERSION on these paths. A later layout version with compatible size can therefore produce incorrect keeper decisions while transactions reject. No same-version attacker write or present fund loss was proved.
description: A future layout upgrade can make the keeper use incompatible account fields because it does not check the stored versions.

LEAD | program: shortwin_keeper | function: prepare_pamm_trader | bug_class: stale-external-account-readiness | group_key: shortwin_keeper | prepare_pamm_trader | stale-external-account-readiness
file: services/keeper/src/keeper.rs:2235 (out-of-bundle context); services/keeper/src/graduation.rs:398; services/keeper/src/venue.rs:412; programs/shortwin/src/venues/pump_amm.rs:503
title: The keeper retains readiness after external accounts close
seam: execution×periphery×first-principles
code_smells: The keeper retains an unchanged readiness list without another account read; the program requires each recipient ATA to exist for every trade.
description: The keeper skips account checks after preparation; a closed recipient ATA may block automated exits, but recipient closure and operational recovery remain unverified.
trace: (1) graduation::pamm_accounts_of and venue::pamm_account_keys include the chosen protocol and buyback recipients' WSOL ATAs. (2) prepare_pamm_trader calls missing_pamm once and records pamm_ready[market] after successful preparation or an empty missing set. (3) Assume one of these external recipients closes its WSOL ATA while the recipient key remains unchanged. (4) The next prepare_pamm_trader sees the same list at keeper.rs:2235 and returns before missing_pamm. (5) liquidate/expire/close_short use venues::parse with Carry::Trade; pump_amm::check_trade checks each recipient ATA with is_wsol_account and rejects its now-empty System account with VenueAccountMismatch. (6) A full-file search of keeper.rs found pamm_ready initialization and inserts but no removal, so this preparation path does not repair the missing ATA on later ticks.
violated_principle: The keeper should restore the external accounts that forced exits require after those accounts disappear.
proof: In-scope venue.rs:412–457 constructs the account list; graduation.rs:398–415 constructs idempotent ATA creation instructions with the keeper payer. In-scope pump_amm.rs:461–467 rejects an empty/non-token account; check_trade at 503–548 requires recipient ATAs to pass it. Out-of-bundle keeper.rs:2197–2213 reads missing accounts, but 2235–2237 skips that read for a cached list; 2240 and 2250 populate the cache. This establishes the stale-cache branch, not a complete in-scope exploit.
guards_and_limits: The account list changes when the chosen recipient or creator changes, which causes a fresh read. Anyone can recreate a recipient ATA externally. A keeper restart clears the process-local cache. The recipient is externally configured, so this is not evidence of an arbitrary unauthenticated caller's ability to close it. The external token-account authority/close-authority state and production operational recovery were not verified. The implementation that owns the cache, keeper.rs, is outside the frozen source bundle; retain as a context-supported lead, not an in-scope finding.
missing_proof: Establish that a selected recipient can and does close the required ATA without changing the key, and inspect deployed operational recovery before judging practical severity.
minimal_fix_candidate: Invalidate pamm_ready after account-validation failures, or periodically recheck the accounts before relying on cached readiness.
